options.description: One command opens a case from what you or the agent noticed (e.g. 'plumb debug report <words>'); the background fixer takes it from there. Cheap; relies on someone noticing.
options.label: Anyone flags it (Recommended)

options.description: plumb watches for specific patterns (a held landing you then override unchanged, a question unanswered for days) and opens a case. Catches without anyone noticing; each detector is new code.
options.label: Named detectors

options.description: Wrong results stay invisible to self-repair.
options.label: Crashes only

payload.question: Today a case opens only when plumb crashes or refuses. A wrong result (a proof check that passed wrongly, a hold that blocked a landing it shouldn't, a question nobody answers) opens nothing. How should those be caught?
